works_well.theme: Family feels reassured and at peace

works_well.theme: Emergency button reaches a helpful operator quickly

reader_notes: 181 of 220 items are app store reviews (116 Apple, 65 Google), mostly about the Lively Link / GreatCall Link family app rather than the alert device itself, and dated 2014-2026 with most from 2015-2020; many complaints repeat the same app-version problems (sign-in loops in 2017-2019, location and iPhone notification bugs 2024-2026). App store reviews lean toward strong opinions. Reddit posts (37) were mostly people asking about Jitterbug phones before buying; only 15 described real use and were kept. Four reviews were written by the device wearer, not a caregiver, and were dropped. Very little evidence on privacy or on who pays beyond the writer.
